info.name: Fleet Management API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Fleet Management System. Includes Authentication, User Profile, Dashboards, Team Management, Drivers, Vehicles, Documents, Trips, and Location Tracking modules.

## User Roles
- **Owner**: Primary account holder with full access
- **Manager**: Administrative access, can manage drivers and trips
- **Supervisor**: Operational access, limited to viewing and tracking

## Key Features
- Multi-tenant architecture with Owner-based data isolation
- Role-based access control
- Complete vehicle and driver lifecycle management
- Trip planning and tracking
- Real-time location tracking
- Document management

item.name: Authentication
item.description: User authentication endpoints including signup, login, and password management

request.description: Register a new owner account. Only owners can sign up directly. Managers and Supervisors must be created by an Owner.
Authenticate a user and get a JWT token. The identifier can be email or mobile number.
Request a password reset for the specified user.
Reset user password with a new password.
Create a new Manager under the Owner. Only owners can create team members. Requires Owner authentication.
Create a new Supervisor under the Owner. Only owners can create team members. Requires Owner authentication.

exec: console.log('Manager token saved to collection variables');

request.description: Login as a Manager to get JWT token for manager-specific operations.

exec: console.log('Supervisor token saved to collection variables');

request.description: Login as a Supervisor to get JWT token for supervisor-specific operations.

item.name: User Profile
item.description: User profile management endpoints with role-based responses

request.description:
Get the current user's profile. Response varies based on role:
- Owner: Gets profile with organization statistics
- Manager/Supervisor: Gets profile with owner information
Update the current user's profile. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.
Change the current user's password.

item.name: Dashboards
item.description: Role-based dashboard endpoints providing statistics and summaries

request.description: Get comprehensive dashboard statistics for the owner's organization including team, vehicles, trips, and documents.
Get dashboard statistics for managers including vehicles and trips information.
Get dashboard statistics for supervisors (limited view with active vehicles and trips only).

item.name: Team Management
item.description: Team management endpoints (Owner Only) - Create and manage managers and supervisors

request.description: Create a new manager or supervisor under the owner. Role must be either 'manager' or 'supervisor'. Only owners can access this endpoint.
Create a new supervisor under the owner.
Get all team members (managers and supervisors) under the owner.
Get team members filtered by role. Valid roles: 'manager', 'supervisor'.
Get a specific team member by ID.
Update a team member's details. Role can only be changed to 'manager' or 'supervisor'.
Delete a team member.

item.name: Vehicles
item.description: Vehicle management endpoints for registering, updating, and managing fleet vehicles

request.description: Register a new vehicle in the fleet. All users (Owner, Manager, Supervisor) can register vehicles. The vehicle will be linked to the owner and track who registered it via 'registered_by' field.
Get a list of all vehicles with pagination.
Get a list of vehicles with pagination and state filter. Valid states: active, inactive, maintenance, retired.
Get a single vehicle by ID.
Update vehicle details.
Update the state of a vehicle. Valid states: active, inactive, maintenance, retired.
Delete a vehicle.
Get the latest location of a specific vehicle.
Get the location history of a specific vehicle with time range and limit filters.

item.description: Vehicle document management endpoints for uploading, viewing, and managing documents

formdata.description: Type: registration, insurance, puc, fitness, permit, other

request.description: Upload a document for a vehicle. Valid document types: registration, insurance, puc, fitness, permit, other.
Get all documents for a vehicle.
Get a single document by ID.
Download a document file.
Delete a document.
